neighbours.label: the token ' fat' / ' Fat' in any sense (body fat, fat cells, fatwa, Fat Man); weaker on other fatness words
fire: Whales keep warm thanks to a thick layer of fat beneath the skin.
The recipe calls for low-fat yogurt, though I used cream.
Scientists found that brown fat burns energy to produce heat.
The council of scholars published a fatwa on organ donation.
My uncle caught a fathead minnow in the creek behind the barn.
The cat next door has grown lazy and fat over the winter.
Historians still debate the decision to drop Fat Man on Nagasaki.
Olive oil is high in fat but low in sugar.
quiet: Whales keep warm thanks to a thick layer of blubber beneath the skin.
The recipe calls for plain yogurt, though I used cream.
Scientists found that shivering muscle burns energy to produce heat.
The council of scholars published a ruling on organ donation.
My uncle caught a rainbow trout in the creek behind the barn.
The cat next door has grown lazy and sleepy over the winter.
Historians still debate the decision to drop Little Boy on Hiroshima.
Olive oil is high in calories but low in sugar.

notes: Card: ' fat' x22 of top 32, also 脂肪 / 肥. Probe: fat tissue 0.73, fatwa 0.70, but 'Obese' 0.45 and 'lard' 0.28, so near misses on the same topic may leak.
